```json
{
  "subtype": "faceted_decomposition",
  "concept": "airline_competitive_advantage",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "cabin_crew_service_quality",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Service quality delivered by cabin crew is a genuine constitutive aspect of an airline's competitive advantage in the passenger-experience dimension."
    },
    {
      "name": "aircraft_cleanliness_maintenance",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Cabin cleanliness and maintenance is an aspect of the product/hardware experience an airline offers, a legitimate part-of the advantage concept."
    },
    {
      "name": "aircraft_modernity",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Fleet modernity is a facet of the airline's physical product offering; however it overlaps materially with cleanliness_maintenance since the dominant value 'well_maintained_modern' blends the two aspects."
    },
    {
      "name": "ground_service_efficiency",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Ground/airport service efficiency (check-in, boarding) is a distinct constitutive aspect of the end-to-end service advantage."
    },
    {
      "name": "fare_value_proposition",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Price/value proposition is a core facet of competitive advantage and does not overlap with the service or product facets."
    }
  ],
  "facet_columns": [
    "cabin_crew_service_quality",
    "aircraft_cleanliness_maintenance",
    "aircraft_modernity",
    "ground_service_efficiency",
    "fare_value_proposition"
  ],
  "non_facet_columns": [],
  "mutual_exclusivity": 0.6,
  "exhaustiveness": 0.55,
  "rationale": "All five columns are true meronymic facets of airline competitive advantage rather than external predictors, causes, or restatements, so the part-of requirement is met. Mutual exclusivity is lowered by the substantial conceptual and empirical overlap between aircraft_cleanliness_maintenance and aircraft_modernity: both target the physical aircraft/hardware aspect and their top values ('well_maintained_modern', 'clean_well_maintained') conflate cleanliness with modernity, so they do not cleanly carve non-overlapping aspects. Exhaustiveness is moderate: the set covers crew service, physical product (two overlapping facets), ground service, and price/value, but omits salient constitutive facets such as seat comfort/legroom, food & beverage quality, inflight entertainment/connectivity, and network/schedule/reliability (punctuality) — several of which are prominent advantage aspects and are even present as original columns. The set is coherent but skews toward hardware and under-covers the in-flight comfort and operational-reliability dimensions of the concept."
}
```
